text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, oseltamivir phosphate inventory across three sites covers 15 to 21 days. Corvale East holds 331 units of 45 mg capsules (21.1 days) and 233 units of 75 mg capsules (17.1 days). Corvale General holds 341.3 units (21.3 days) and 297.99 units (18.2 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 47 units of 75 mg (14.6 days). No FDA shortage listing exists for this drug.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show no shortage listing for oseltamivir phosphate as of 2026-10-21. The label for NDC 64380079801 names Strides Pharma Science Limited Bengaluru - 562106 as the manufacturing plant; that plant has not been placed in our records. An alternative label for NDC 68788406601 names Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. (FEI 3004582966) as a registered relabeling plant with a VAI inspection on 2025-05-27.

Our position: Current stock is limited to 15–21 days across sites. The Strides manufacturing plant requires verification for placement in our records. Allocation from A-S Medication Solutions must be confirmed to cover the 15 to 20 day range. All ranked purchase options (A-S Medication Solutions, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Alvogen Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC) are not on FDA’s shortage list today, and their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies whether the Strides Pharma Science Limited Bengaluru plant can be placed in our records.
2. Buyer confirms allocation from A-S Medication Solutions to cover 15 to 20 days across all sites.
3. Buyer evaluates ranked purchase options 1 through 5 for plant placement feasibility and supply terms.
4. Pharmacy director approves any new purchase agreements resulting from action 3.
5. P&T committee reviews and approves any formulary changes if alternative products are selected.

Not recommended: Initiating clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions without P&T committee review and treating clinician approval.
